summary: Transform your frontline operations with our specialized training. Equip your staff with the skills needed for effective management and exceptional service.
lede: Frontline staff training equips supervisors, team leaders, and managers to guide daily service work and build team capability. It covers identifying training needs, structuring briefings and on-the-job learning, coaching with actionable feedback, and addressing performance or service challenges fairly while supporting staff wellbeing and consistent standards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage or support frontline teams across various sectors.
audience: Supervisors and team leaders in customer service
Retail floor managers and shift supervisors
Field service or sales team leaders
modules: The Role of Frontline Teams in Organizational Success
Coaching and Feedback in Real Time
Service Excellence and Customer Experience on the Frontline
Communication, Team Briefings, and Shift Handover
Action Planning and Sustaining Frontline Excellence
prerequisites: Participants should have experience managing or supporting frontline teams, and access to a team for applying course learnings.
